_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 7 — arm 4 with the SINGLE change
estimation.ionosphere_weighting.elevation_cutoff_deg 25.0 -> 10.0.
WHY THIS LEVER.  The receiver-DCB datum (arm 4) fixed the DRIFT but not the OFFSET: a00
starts at 12.78 TECU in every EXT-CB arm against COD's own GIM at 32.24 TECU for this
epoch.  Arm 6 eliminated frequency mode as the cause (triple reproduced dual to 0.1 TECU).
What is left is the physics that separates the ionosphere LEVEL from the receiver DCBs:
a uniform DCB shift is compensated by a slant-iono shift, and slant maps to VTEC through
M(el), so ONLY THE MAPPING-FUNCTION SPREAD over the admitted elevation range breaks the
confounding.  The FT63 lineage admits iono rows only above 25 deg, which is a deliberately
NARROW spread.  Widening to 10 deg roughly doubles the M range and is the most direct test
of whether the offset is a separability failure.
⚠️ THIS TRADES AGAINST A KNOWN, DOCUMENTED EFFECT — do not read a move as a free win.
The posture ledger records the 25 deg cutoff as LOAD-BEARING precisely because the SH
field is fed a per-epoch CODE-derived slant iono, so low-elevation code multipath and
residual troposphere contaminate a00.  Lowering the cutoff therefore buys separability and
pays in contamination.  Both effects move a00, in the SAME direction for the wrong
reasons, so this arm alone cannot promote the setting.
READ IT AS A MECHANISM TEST:
a00 moves substantially toward 32 TECU  => the offset IS a separability failure driven
by the mapping-function spread.  The FIX is then not this knob but a richer iono
representation and/or an explicit receiver-DCB tie to an external reference; this
arm only identifies the mechanism.
a00 stays near 13 TECU  => separability is NOT the binding constraint, and the leading
remaining hypothesis is a REPRESENTATION MISMATCH: COD's satellite DCBs were
determined against COD's OWN ionosphere (deg-15 IONEX, their mapping function,
their weighting).  Holding their DCBs fixed while our deg-8 SH field at a 450 km
shell represents the same field differently forces OUR field to absorb the
difference.  That is consistent with the standing W6 finding that the satellite-DCB
residual is SYSTEMATIC ('deg-8 SH representation leaking into the GF split') and
that 'a richer iono field is the lever'.  Next test would then be SH degree 8 -> 15.
Dual frequency, since arm 6 exonerated it and it is the faster of the two.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY.
